quote_original: The time is fulfilled, now, in us, for sacred history is over.
context_before: Creation is over. It is finished.
context_after: Secular history is a changing thing that will, in time, wither like a plant and fade like a flower. No matter how great a nation is today, tomorrow it will vanish. So in the midst of these changing series of events of secular history stands the unchanging salvation of Jesus Christ.
